messages.subject: [IT] Planned DMS maintenance — Saturday 17 January 20:00-23:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The document management system (NetDocs) will be unavailable this Saturday 17 January between 20:00 and 23:00 GMT for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please save and close all documents before 19:45. Email will be unaffected. Apologies for any inconvenience.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
x4357
